text: Risk management is the process of dealing with possible problems before they happen. First, you need to identify risks, which means finding things that could go wrong. For example, a company might worry about losing important data. Next, you develop mitigation strategies to reduce these risks, such as backing up files every day. It is also wise to create contingency plans, which are actions you will take if the problem actually occurs. Finally, you must keep monitoring the situation, because new risks can appear at any time. By following these steps, you can protect your project and respond calmly to challenges.
